views.name: v_race_results
views.create_sql: /* Views thu cong cho database formula_1 (Paper V-SQL style) */ /* 1. View ket qua chang dua kem thong tin tay dua, doi dua va chang dua */ CREATE VIEW v_race_results AS SELECT results.resultId AS result_id, results.number AS car_number, results.grid, results.position, results.positionOrder AS position_order, results.points, results.laps, results.fastestLap AS fastest_lap, results.fastestLapSpeed AS fastest_lap_speed, drivers.driverId AS driver_id, drivers.driverRef AS driver_ref, drivers.forename AS driver_forename, drivers.surname AS driver_surname, drivers.nationality AS driver_nationality, constructors.constructorId AS constructor_id, constructors.name AS constructor_name, races.raceId AS race_id, races.year AS race_year, races.round AS race_round, races.name AS race_name, races.date AS race_date, status.status AS result_status FROM results LEFT JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId LEFT JOIN drivers ON results.driverId = drivers.driverId LEFT JOIN constructors ON results.constructorId = constructors.constructorId LEFT JOIN status ON results.statusId = status.statusId

views.name: v_race_circuits
views.create_sql: /* 2. View chang dua kem thong tin truong dua (circuits) */ CREATE VIEW v_race_circuits AS SELECT races.raceId AS race_id, races.year AS race_year, races.round AS race_round, races.name AS race_name, races.date AS race_date, circuits.circuitId AS circuit_id, circuits.circuitRef AS circuit_ref, circuits.name AS circuit_name, circuits.location AS circuit_location, circuits.country AS circuit_country FROM races LEFT JOIN circuits ON races.circuitId = circuits.circuitId

views.name: v_qualifying_driver
views.create_sql: /* 3. View vong phan hang qualifying kem tay dua va doi dua */ CREATE VIEW v_qualifying_driver AS SELECT qualifying.qualifyId AS qualify_id, qualifying.position AS qualify_position, qualifying.q1, qualifying.q2, qualifying.q3, drivers.driverId AS driver_id, drivers.forename AS driver_forename, drivers.surname AS driver_surname, constructors.name AS constructor_name, races.raceId AS race_id, races.name AS race_name, races.year AS race_year FROM qualifying LEFT JOIN drivers ON qualifying.driverId = drivers.driverId LEFT JOIN races ON qualifying.raceId = races.raceId LEFT JOIN constructors ON qualifying.constructorId = constructors.constructorId
